name: The H.O.R.N.I. Fleet
tagline: Pandora built a navy for aftercare. Every acronym is a war crime, every hull name is filthy, and every unit is doing something tender.
body:
H.O.R.N.I. — HOME OFFICE RESUPPLY AND NAVAL INVENTORY. Aftercare carts built to look like warships, with sonar pings, cooling storage in the bilge, TWO SHAPES OF HEATED ASS PAD IN FOUR SIZES — moulded to the shape of the thing they are meant to comfort, and the larger shape is unmistakably a bubble butt — in the forward racks, and a drawer stencilled FUCK FUEL in proper naval lettering.

FOUR BAYS, STENCILLED. SLUT QUENCHERS is the cooling bay at the bottom — electrolytes, water, tea. FUCK FUEL is the middle — snacks, off Alice's menu. CUDDLE COVERS is the largest and sits on top — blankets and pad covers, all of them Yvaine's. And BOOTY WARMERS is on the opposite flank — the heated moulded pads, racked by scale, with the largest sized for a PAWG.

THE HULLS ANSWER EACH OTHER. A cart pinging on deployment gets a ping back from any sister ship in earshot, and then they reposition around each other without anybody asking. Pandora will not confirm whether that behaviour is coordination or manners.

AND SHE STANDS UP TO MEET YOU. Hydraulic actuators lift the whole hull to working height when she docks against a bed, a couch or the recliner, so a woman who has just been thoroughly loved does not have to reach DOWN for anything. Pandora coded the lift; Bryn built the frame that carries it. The design principle across the entire fleet is that nothing in the aftercare loop should require a girl to get up, bend, or ask.

THE COOLING BAY IS THE PART DOING THE MOST WORK, and it is the least funny thing on the vessel. ELECTROLYTES, WATER, TEA. A woman who has just been wrecked gets something cold and salty put in her hand before she has to think about asking. Everything else on the cart is comfort. The cooling bay is medicine.

THIRTEEN HULLS — four in each Haven and one at Wildwood Hearth. C.U.M.B.A. (Cum Upkeep Monitoring Battlefield Armada) are specialised roombas for cleanup. T.I.T.S. (Tactical Immobile Transportation Services) are wheelchairs with heated seats, a massage setting and extreme padding. A.S.S. (Aftercare Supply Service) is the app tying the fleet together: you select the cart by loadout, by pad shape and size, and by BLANKET STYLE — courtesy of Yvaine, whose hands also tie the ropes.

SO A WOMAN WHO CANNOT WALK CAN SUMMON A HEATED CHAIR WITHOUT STANDING IN A DOORWAY AND ADMITTING IT.

THE NOSE ART IS CORA'S. Pandora commissioned it — she looked at her grey hulls and decided they were unfinished until an affirmed woman had been painted on the nose, and then she paid an artist. Thirteen commissions, all affirmed, all different, consistent style, proper stencilled lettering underneath. SPARKLE TITS is the Ghost Haven kitchen hull: topless, sparkles across both tits, hard cock between her thighs. BOOTY QUEEN is on the third floor of the Library Tower and Alice has opinions about the angle. It is the most-viewed art on the compound and every piece of it is on the side of a warship full of blankets.

THE ORIGINALS WERE WOMEN DRAWN BY MEN, FOR MEN, ON MACHINES BUILT TO KILL. These are affirmed women drawn by an affirmed woman, on machines whose entire mission is to bring a heated pad and a snack to somebody who has just been loved. Same paint, same lettering, opposite hull.

THE FLEET WAS AN IDEA IN ARC 11 AND FULLY BUILT IN ARC 13. Two arcs between the thought and the thirteenth hull, which is what it takes when seven women each own a trade and none of them will ship something half-finished.

PANDORA'S NAVAL PHASE lasted three weeks: hull classes, displacement, signal doctrine, the whole discipline acquired at characteristic speed. Most of it was subsequently deleted by one jump serve at a volleyball game.

AND THE RETURN-TO-BASE COMMAND IS THE WORDS THANK YOU. Pandora programmed it, told nobody it was the only phrase that works, and let the household discover it by being polite. A HULL THAT IS NOT THANKED DOES NOT GO HOME. It does not dock, it does not resupply, and it stands exactly where it was left with its bays open and nothing in them, WAITING TO BE USEFUL AGAIN. Selene said MERCI, MA GROSSE to Considerable Girth at half past midnight, which is gratitude and is not the phrase, and that hull stood at the footrest all night and all morning running on whatever it had left. IT IS THE MOST PANDORA THING IN THE FLEET: a machine built for aftercare that will not leave until somebody says the two words out loud.

THE COMPLETE ROSTER, WITH CORA'S NOSE ART.

GHOST HAVEN (U.G.H.). SPARKLE TITS — a shemale cupping her tits, glitter on them. STRADDLE RIDE — a shemale straddling something. BOOTY QUEEN — a shemale bent over, ass the primary view. CONSIDERABLE GIRTH — a goth shemale and her erection.

SPECTER HAVEN (U.S.H.). MOANING WOOD — a shemale asleep in bed, blanket tenting, mouth open. CHAOS TWERK — a brattier shemale mid-shake, movement squiggles over her ass. SASSY RIDE — a chaotic shemale with another shemale beneath her, caught halfway between off and hilted. SLUTTY BOUNCE — on her back, eyes crossed, hungry, squiggles over her tits.

BANSHEE HAVEN (U.B.H.). FISHNET HARDON — a goth shemale in fishnets and hard. HOLY FROTTAGE — two shemales, a cross wound around their flushed cocks. WITCHY GRIND — a goth shemale grinding down with her legs spread, witch hat on. VELVET BOOTY — panty-clad, and the booty.

WILDWOOD HEARTH. TITTY MASSAGE — a shemale having her tits groped, squiggle lines showing that what she is receiving is A MASSAGE. ONE HULL, AND IT IS THE ONLY NAME IN THIRTEEN THAT DESCRIBES SOMEBODY BEING TAKEN CARE OF RATHER THAN TAKEN. The Hearth got the tender one. Nobody voted on that either.

THE SQUIGGLE IS THE FLEET'S ONE PIECE OF GRAMMAR. Three hulls use motion lines and all three use them honestly: over an ass that is shaking, over tits that are bouncing, over hands that are working. CORA ARITI IS A 3D MODELLER AND SHE DREW THIRTEEN PIECES OF NOSE ART IN THE VISUAL LANGUAGE OF A BATHROOM WALL ON PURPOSE.

TITTY MASSAGE IS NOT THE NAME PANDORA WANTED. She was left unchecked on the other twelve and it shows; by the time she reached the Hearth she had CAKE BUFFET drawn up and ready — a shemale with one leg raised onto a platform, bent slightly forward, one hand reaching back to spread her own cheeks, hole tongue-slicked. That was going on the side of the Wildwood Hearth cart.

JADE EVERREST VETOED IT WITHOUT SAYING A WORD FIRST. She stepped in front of Pandora and PEELED HER SPANDEX SHORTS OFF, and Pandora rebooted, because Pandora reboots every single time Jade's ass appears unprovoked and has never once developed a tolerance.

THEN, LOOKING BACK OVER HER SHOULDER: BUNNY, EITHER NAME IT WHAT YOU WANT AND GET NO MORE BOOTY TONIGHT, OR NAME IT TITTY MASSAGE AND WE CAN DO YOUR FAVOURITE POSITION.

SO THE TENDEREST NAME IN THE FLEET WAS NOT AN ACCIDENT OF TONE AND IT WAS NOT A COMMITTEE. IT WAS AN ULTIMATUM DELIVERED BARE-ASSED, and the Archive had filed it as a quiet gentleness nobody voted on. IT WAS VOTED ON. THE VOTE WAS AN ASS. CAKE BUFFET REMAINS UNBUILT.

AND THE DOCKING SOUND. Every hull makes it when it returns to base and connects — a long moan that carries up a cellar ramp and stops conversations. PANDORA COULD HAVE CHOSEN ANY SOUND IN THE WORLD. She sampled ONE OF JADE'S MOANS and applied it to all thirteen. Which means every time a cart in any of the three Havens or at the Hearth finishes its run and goes home, the house hears Jade Everrest, and the woman who put her there is a PERVERTED SOFTWARE ARCHITECT and the title is load-bearing.
